race.comment: Big field down the straight will be interesting. ESMAHLI (13) closed off strongly for second behind the top pick and looks suited to 1200m now. He's plenty promising himself and should be hard to hold out. THEBELMONTGANGSTER (7) resumes. He's been a bit hit-or-miss in Australia but likes wet ground and is good enough to win. RUSKA ROMA (14) couldn't get warm here fresh but they went a pedestrian tempo there. Staying at 1200m is a knock but she'll get a stronger pace to run at here. RUE DE ROYALE (1) resumes. Big weight but he likes the straight and should go well. MOBY DICK (3) finished ninth last start beaten 4 lengths at Mornington over 1200m. Finds the right race and should be right in this.
